locator: GoedelGod.thy, A1b: "[∀(λΦ. m¬ (P Φ) m→ P (λx. m¬ (Φ x)))]"
interpretation: Axiom A1b as stated in the theory, read through its abbreviations (validity is truth at every world; m¬, m→ are pointwise). It is the 'either' half of the theory's gloss 'Either a property or its negation is positive, but not both'. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Scott's notes, not to what Scott or Gödel intended.
